reference.title: Qualidade do ar interior em ambientes nao residenciais climatizados artificialmente - Padroes referenciais
reference.note: Technical reference for non-residential indoor air. 24h criteria must not be converted into instantaneous compliance.

parameterDefinition.name: PM2.5
parameterDefinition.description: Fine particulate matter mass concentration. 24-hour averages apply for 24h criterion.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: ABNT NBR 17037:2023 (Versao Corrigida 2:2024), criterion expressed as 24-hour mean.

criteria.methodNote: ABNT NBR 17037 criterion is a 24-hour mean reference. Instantaneous readings are observational and require historical assessment.
criteria.temporalGuidance: A current reading may be flagged as above the reference value, but 24-hour compliance requires the corresponding observation period.

curation.curationNotes: Curated from consolidated dossier. ABNT PM2.5 reference retained as technical 24h criterion without converting to instantaneous compliance.

validation.validationNotes: Consolidated dossier indicates corrected version context and secondary-copy limitation. Independent primary-source validation remains pending.
